title: Special UFO briefing for maintenance teams

tellings.quote: This time they brought us into a special briefing and they told us there's UFOs out in the area.

plain: A former Air Force officer named Robert Salas, who served at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, a base that controlled nuclear missiles, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about March 1967. Passing on what a man named Robert Jameson told him, Salas says the maintenance teams were called into a special briefing and told there were UFOs out in the area. If true, it would mean the military knew of UFOs near its nuclear missiles and warned its own crews.
